messages:
alex: Quick sync — I'm going to start a gated enablement for structured_output + function_call on hosted. Goal: small, observable canary first, then widen if metrics look good.

priya: Thanks Alex. Quick Q: what does "compat" look like for older client SDKs? Will calls without the new SDK get different response shapes?

sam: They should be backward-compatible. Plan is: default server behaviour is unchanged unless the client opt-ins or the compat flag is on. New flag names: `so_enabled`, `so_compat_mode`, `fncall_client_behavior`.

kai: FYI PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4523 — contains server gating + a small telemetry shim. CI green, needs eng-runtime review.

alex: Putting the rollout config here for visibility:

```json
{
  "so_enabled": false,
  "so_compat_mode": "fallback-text",    // options: "strict", "fallback-text", "shim"
  "fncall_client_behavior": "opt-in",  // "opt-in" | "auto" | "disabled"
  "canary": {
    "audiences": ["internal-dev", "platform-stage"],
    "percent": 5
  }
}
```

maria: Can we make the first wave internal-only (internal-dev + staging) for 48h? Then expand to 5% external dev orgs. Need to avoid surprising production customers.

alex: Yes — step 1 = 48h internal. Step 2 = 5% external dev orgs (experimental flag). Step 3 = 25% with broad telemetry.

priya: What telemetry should we watch? I propose: 1) % of calls returning `structured_output` vs text 2) function_call invocation error rate 3) latency p50/p95 4) model-level quality regression on our eval set (prompt suite).

sam: Add: user-facing error rate (500s), schema validation failures, and any increase in rerank retries. Also watch token usage delta (cost).

kai: For SDK behavior: current plan is `fncall_client_behavior: opt-in` for the initial phases. DevEx will ship a patch so `0.x` clients get a warning header with guidance. Newer SDKs can opt into `auto` once we've widened the rollout.

priya: Who signs off to move from internal->external? eng-runtime + devex + product sign-off. Product wants a canary checklist (short).

alex: Draft checklist:
- [x] PR merged with toggle + telemetry (PR 4523)
- [x] DevEx doc for SDK changes published (internal)
- [x] QA smoke plan (see below)
- [ ] 48h internal run with monitoring alerts enabled
- [ ] 5% external for 72h; run evals daily
- [ ] Expand to 25% if no regressions

maria: QA smoke plan (short):
- run ~200 sample prompts across promptsuite v2 that exercise function_call paths
- validate structured_output schema via our validator (local)
- simulate partial network failures to ensure graceful fallback
- confirm no breaking changes for non-opt-in SDKs

qa-bot: Automated check run: smoke-tests/so-fncall v1 -> 0 failures (local), 3 flaky on staging (being investigated).

priya: Can we set a hard kill switch? If errors spike, we need an immediate global disable. Who has authority to toggle?

alex: eng-sre + eng-runtime leads can flip the global flag. I'll add an emergency runbook in the playbook repo and a pager signal.

sam: Also add an automated rule: if function_call error rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR schema validation failures > 0.5% -> auto-disable and open incident.

kai: DevEx note: update SDK changelog + add `X-So-Compat: shim` response header when we shim outputs for older clients.

maria: I'll schedule the internal rollout for tomorrow 09:00 PT, 48h window. Can folks review PR/telemetry today?

alex: Thanks everyone. Action items:
- sam/kai: finish runtime review + merge PR (today)
- priya: publish SDK advisory + changelog (today)
- maria: kick internal canary tomorrow 09:00 PT
- eng-sre: add auto-disable rules in alerts

deploy-bot: Feature flag update scheduled: `so_enabled` -> gated (internal), `fncall_client_behavior` -> "opt-in" at 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z :rocket:

alex: Ping me if you want to be in the internal audience list. :thumbsup:
